text: Coffee with Lila. Her dad's had a fall and broke his wrist, cast comes off sometime next week. She's driving up to see him this weekend. Her daughter Nia has a piano recital on Thursday too, poor thing is juggling everything.
Oisín's band are playing the Grand Social on Friday. He says the new drummer is still learning the set. I'm going with Dana, already got tickets.
Henrik and his wife got a puppy! Cocker spaniel called Biscuit, eight weeks old. Puppy classes start next Tuesday. He looked shattered but very happy.
Need to text Duc tomorrow to see how his knee scan went. He's been limping since the 10k and his physio thinks it might be the meniscus.

Long catch-up with Dmitri. His son Pasha has tonsillitis again and they're seeing the ENT consultant early November about taking them out. Dmitri's wife Olga is back at work full time now. He's still doing the Sunday league, they've got a cup match this weekend. Dmitri says he's knackered but fine.
Alice's cat Pickle has kidney problems, vet wants to recheck bloods in a fortnight. She's really upset about it. Should drop round with something nice for her on Saturday.
Ibrahim is running the Dublin half at the end of the month. First proper race since his hamstring tear, and he's nervous about it. Must wish him luck the night before.
Pieter called. His mum is in hospital with pneumonia, they think she'll be in until Monday at least. He's flying over to Rotterdam tomorrow morning.
Seo-yeon's choir concert was cancelled because half of them have flu. Rescheduled for early December apparently. She's gutted, she had a solo.
Kemal mentioned his daughter Ayla got into the county under-14 netball squad. First tournament is over the half term. He's beaming.
Dong and Hana are doing the couples dance competition in Leeds next Saturday. They've been practising every night. Hana's ankle is strapped but she says it's fine.
Tunde's dog Rex turns ten on Wednesday. He's throwing it a little party in the park lol. Apparently Rex is mad about those squeaky hedgehog toys, could bring one.
Remind me: Aditi's surgery is Thursday. Text her Wednesday evening, then check in with Rahul on Friday to see how she's doing.
Bumped into Ava outside the school. Her son has chickenpox so she's off work all week. She asked if I'd heard about Sofia's play, opening night is the 14th.
Sofia Rossi is playing Lady Macbeth in the amdram production, runs three nights from the 14th. She's terrified about the sleepwalking scene. Get tickets for the Saturday.
Yetunde had a chat about her brother Emeka, he's been struggling since the accident and can't drive for another couple of months. She's covering his school runs. I think she's exhausted.
Kiara's parrot Mango has gone off his food and is plucking feathers. Avian vet on Monday. She's convinced it's stress from the building works next door.
Khadija loves anything to do with Formula 1, mentioned she's never been to a race. Christmas gift idea maybe? Silverstone tickets go on sale over the summer.
Lwazi and Bridget are doing the Dublin marathon relay together on Sunday. Bridget's on the hilly leg. Lwazi has been off with a chest infection so he's not sure he'll manage his bit.
Kate rang about her dad, he's having a cataract operation sometime next week. She'll drive him in and stay over. I said I'd feed her cats while she's away.
Chantal's son Theo has his grade 5 violin exam on Tuesday. He's been practising scales nonstop. Chantal is more nervous than he is!
Ask Aoife how the vet visit went for Luna, her new kitten had the snip yesterday.
Kalani has shingles, nasty case, doctor signed her off for two weeks. She's bored stiff. Should send her some books.
Groceries, bin day is Thursday not Wednesday this week, and book the car in for a service sometime next week.

Gig recap: Oisín was brilliant last night. Henrik came too, and he's asked whether we fancy the Henrik-and-friends five-a-side tournament in early March. Oisín's sister Maeve is visiting from Galway this weekend so he's busy till Monday.
Dana's mum has been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes. Dana is taking her to a dietitian on Friday and is reading up on everything. Her mum's apparently in denial about the sweets.
Nia passed her grade 3 piano! Lila sent a video. Need to get Nia a little something, she's mad about cats so maybe a cat notebook.
Duc's knee is a torn meniscus after all. Op is booked for end of the month. He's gutted about missing the rest of the season.
Spoke to Olga at the school gate. Pasha's tonsils come out on the 3rd. She's anxious, he's only six. Also her cat Boris is on a diet, vet says he's a stone too heavy.
Alice update: Pickle's bloods were better than expected. Vet says keep the special food going and recheck over the summer. Alice is so relieved.
Text Ibrahim congrats. He finished the half in 1:42, PB, no hamstring issues. He's already talking about the Rome marathon in March.
Pieter's mum is home now. Still very weak and his sister Femke is staying with her for a fortnight. He's back at work Monday. Call him at the weekend.
Rahul said Aditi came through the surgery fine, she's sore but in good spirits. She'll be off work until mid November. Maybe drop flowers round on Sunday.
Kemal Usman, aka Kem, is organising the charity quiz at the cricket club on Friday the 7th. Said I'd do a round on music.
Dong's band have a slot at the battle of the bands next Thursday. Seo-yeon is doing their poster. Dong's worried the bassist won't show.
Hana has a stress fracture in her foot, so the dance competition is off. She has to wear a boot for six weeks. Dong is really disappointed for her.
Tunde said Rex's party was a hit, eleven dogs turned up. Rex now has arthritis meds though, vet put him on them on Tuesday.
Remember to ask Ava whether her little one is back at school yet. Chickenpox should be clearing by Thursday.
Yetunde's daughter Funmi has her first gymnastics competition on Saturday morning. Yetunde's flapping about the 6am start. Emeka is going to watch, first outing since the accident.
Watch the match at Kiara's on Sunday, I'm bringing snacks. Her brother Jayden is coming down from Manchester.
Khadija says her husband Bilal is training for the Three Peaks challenge in early June. He's done his back in twice already. She's not keen.
Bridget's knee went on the relay leg. A&E said ligament strain, crutches for a couple of weeks. Lwazi ended up running both legs. Check on Bridget tomorrow.
Kate's dad's operation went well, he can see colours again he says. Kate is heading back home Wednesday. Her cats were fine with me.
Theo passed the violin exam with distinction. Chantal is over the moon. He's got a recital at the school end of term.
Aoife's new puppy Bran is chewing everything, including her shoes. She's taking a week off sometime in November to settle him in. Her partner Niamh is allergic, which is a whole thing.
Kalani's feeling a bit better, the rash is going. She's hoping to be back at the climbing wall by early December. She's into bouldering competitions, entered one in January.
Need to buy a birthday card for Mum and post it by Friday.

Lila's dad had his cast off on Tuesday but the wrist is still stiff, physio twice a week now. Lila is worn out from the driving. Her husband Marco is doing the school runs meanwhile. I should invite her round for dinner next weekend, she needs a break.
Henrik's puppy Biscuit got into the bin and ate a sock. Emergency vet last night, all fine now thankfully. Henrik says never again.
Emeka is back driving from next Monday. He said Yetunde has been amazing. He's thinking about going back to five-a-side in the spring.
Dmitri's team won the cup match 3-1. He scored! Also he's coeliac, which I didn't know, so no pizza for the celebration.
Seo-yeon's choir concert finally happened Saturday. Her solo went perfectly. She's auditioning for the chamber choir sometime next week and is a nervous wreck about it. Wish her luck Monday.
Oisín's grandad passed away on Sunday. The funeral is Thursday in Cork. Oisín is heading down tomorrow. Send him a message tonight.
Pieter Smith from work, quiet guy, keeps bees and sells honey at the farmers market on Saturdays. Hates football.
Nothing major. Walked the long way home, sun was out.
Duc's op went OK yesterday, he's on crutches. His girlfriend Lan is looking after him. Pop over with some games for him this weekend.
Ava's daughter Rosie starts swimming lessons on Wednesday afternoons. Ava is worried she'll catch something else, she's had three bugs since September. Ava's been really run down herself.
Sofia's play went brilliantly by all accounts, sold out Saturday. She's already been asked to direct the spring panto. Kate and I want to take her out for a drink to celebrate, maybe Friday week.

Big catch-up with Kiara and Tunde at the pub. Kiara's parrot Mango is eating again, vet thinks it was a vitamin thing. Tunde's mum has a hip replacement booked for early February and he's nervous for her. His sister Bisi lives nearby so she'll do most of the caring. Tunde is also running his first ultra in the summer.
Bridget off crutches by Halloween hopefully. Lwazi's got a cold now, the irony. Their wedding anniversary is next Friday, they're going away to Kerry for the weekend.
